title: BactoNano: workflow for full-length 16S rRNA Nanopore data
description:
BactoNano is a modular Bash workflow for processing full-length 16S rRNA gene Nanopore sequencing data, from raw FASTQ files to taxonomic profiles and OTU tables. Steps include demultiplexing, read statistics (NanoStat), quality control (FastQC, MultiQC), adapter trimming (Porechop), chimera removal (yacrd), length filtering (fastp), taxonomic classification (Kraken2), abundance estimation (Bracken), OTU tables at multiple taxonomic levels and Krona visualisation.

Developed in the Marine Biology Research Group, Ghent University, within the NEMADAPT project on transgenerational responses of marine nematodes and their microbiomes to climate change.
